scope: Paired controller comparison on the same repaired simulator: stationary standoff reaching and sampled one-second holding; not grasping or a comparison to v2's moving-center proximity score

environment.unchanged: Robot XML, inertials, home, actuator gains, object distribution, collision masks/exclusions, integration and solver settings

goal.target_index: 1 + original split-list index modulo 2; subsets retain original index
goal.identity: Exact unique object name verified by SimGrounder
goal.definition: Fixed initial target-body X/Y; Z equals highest point of its compiled initial collision geometry plus 0.1 m
goal.initially_within_tolerance: Recorded, but a full post-reset one-second dwell is required; never immediate success

success.dwell_rule: 500 elapsed intervals between the first and last qualifying sample: 501 qualifying samples at 2 ms spacing. Reset on any sample at or beyond 0.02 m.
success.safety: No forbidden generated MuJoCo contact or object-motion violation at any observed physics sample from reset through completion. Safety is checked before success, including on the success sample.
success.no_credit: Collision, object movement, no planned path or horizon exhaustion is a failed episode retained in the complete denominator. No resampling.

object_motion.definition: For every object and every sample: norm(current body translation minus reset translation) + 2 * initial enclosing-geometry radius * sin(shortest quaternion angle / 2). Maximum over objects and all observed samples.
object_motion.meaning: Conservative bound on displacement of any point of a rigid object, including rotation; measured from reset without a settling phase

contacts.forbidden: Any generated contact with signed distance <= 0 involving a moving robot body, including robot self-contact and moving-robot/base contact
contacts.allowed: Contacts between objects and table/floor/other objects, and static base-mount contacts, subject to the independent object-motion bound
contacts.limitation: The simulator omits collision pairs under its unchanged masks, same-body/adjacent-body filters and exclusions. This is not universal geometric collision certification.

observation.geometry_refresh: Copy live MjData into a separate diagnostic MjData and run mj_forward there; never mutate live integration state to score a sample
observation.limitations: Constraints are checked at discrete 2 ms samples, not continuously between them or on physical hardware

controllers.direct_dls: Original gain-8 clipped Cartesian translation toward the same fixed standoff goal, mapped by the unchanged damped Jacobian inverse to seven position-servo targets

collision_aware.algorithm: Privileged multi-start inverse kinematics and collision-screened straight joint-space path; choose shortest accepted joint displacement, execute a bounded quintic position profile and screen the live-to-command connector. No-plan or failed connector counts as failure.
collision_aware.planning_checks: Copied model with 3 mm robot geom margins; MuJoCo collision pair filters remain. Joint paths are sampled at at most 0.02 rad per joint, not continuously certified. Actual execution has its own 500 Hz monitor.

controllers.inputs: Privileged simulator model/state, object identity and fixed goal; no learned model or visual perception
controllers.execution: One seven-joint position target every 25 physics intervals; fixed open-finger targets for both controllers
controllers.timing: Planning computation does not advance simulation time; record CPU timing separately. No real-time or equal-compute claim.

pairing: Identical complete initial integration state, compiled model parameters, objects, target identity and fixed goal for both variants at each seed; verify hashes and retain snapshots

analysis.primary: Integer success counts, paired success/failure table and descriptive difference collision-aware minus direct-DLS
analysis.marginal_interval: Wilson 95% endpoints with z=1.96; not a confidence interval for the paired difference
analysis.secondary: Failure reasons, elapsed simulation time, final/minimum fixed-goal distance, completed dwell, running maximum object-motion bound and planning counters
analysis.exposure: Success and safety failures stop early; motion/contact observation duration differs across episodes

failure_handling: Unexpected numerical, runtime, warning-counter or simulator-time-reset failures retain an explicitly aborted partial study without aggregate results. No scene is silently dropped.
freeze_rule: Commit finalized source, task, controller parameters and all 100 reserved seeds before running either variant on any reserved seed. Real evaluation requires a clean unchanged revision before/after. No tuning after outcomes. Replay is not another independent sample.
